name: Foryou Corporation
summary: Foryou Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the automotive electronics, precision die casting, precision electronic components, and LED lighting businesses in China and internationally. The company offers in-vehicle infotainment, digital cluster, heads up display, digital rearview mirror, cockpit domain controller, climate controller, wireless charger, around view monitoring, auto parking assistance, blind spot detection, driver monitor system, high-definition cameras, other driver assistance systems, and connected vehicle system services.
